economy.gdp_source: BEA Q1 2026 third estimate (released 6/25/26): +2.1% annualized (advance 2.0%, second 2.6%, third 2.1%). Q4 2025 revised to +0.5%. Contributors: investment, exports, government spending, consumer spending; imports a partial offset. Q2 2026 advance estimate due 7/30/26.
economy.consumer_sentiment_source: University of Michigan, July 2026 preliminary (interviews 6/23-7/13, >70% completed before 7/7 resumption of US-Iran strikes). June 2026 final: 49.5. All five components improved M/M. Year-ahead inflation expectations 4.2% (down from 4.6% in June). Long-run expectations 3.3%. Final July reading due 7/31/26.
economy.unemployment_source: BLS, June 2026 (released 7/2/26). Nonfarm payrolls 159.0M (+100k MoM); U-3: 4.2% (-0.1 pp MoM, down from 4.4% peak in Feb '26); U-6 underemployment: 7.9%; participation rate: 61.5%; jobless claims (Jul '26): 187k (-22k MoM).
